moments.text: Phone video of a light infrared screen: tick-marked crosshair, a small dark ring below-right of centre and a tiny dark dot just left of centre.
A bolder dark ring peeks in at the right edge, then drifts down the lower right and leaves at the bottom edge.
A larger dark double blob enters from the bottom, left of the ring, and rises past the crosshair to leave at the top in about half a second.
The double blob reappears at the upper left and slides down toward the lower left.
The screen flashes white and black as the sensor switches mode; two small rings and a triangle then sit just below-right of the crosshair.
Two more bright flashes; afterwards only one ring remains below-right of the crosshair.
A trail of dark dots enters from the top, merges into one dark dot above-right of centre, and moves left across the vertical crosshair line.
The dark dot hovers just below the crosshair centre, wandering left and right, for the rest of the clip.
The bolder ring rises in from the bottom at the lower right, hangs there for about 2 s, then sinks back out.
The bolder ring appears at the upper right, rises to the top edge, then moves down the right side and leaves at the bottom.
A small circle with a cross inside appears lower right of the crosshair and slides up to sit above-right of its centre.

notes: Same footage as DOW-UAP-PR121 from 8.07 s onward (PR122 t = PR121 t - 8.07). Full-frame recheck: added the bolder ring's two earlier passes at the right edge and the circled-cross marker at the end; dot wanders both sides of centre.
